proof_body:
by
  intro A _ I J h
  have hs := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (I := I)
  have hc : (J.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = J := by
    rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ hs, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.mk_ker]
    exact sup_eq_left.mpr h
  have hker : RingHom.ker (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) ≤ J := by rwa [Ideal.mk_ker]
  constructor
  · constructor
    · intro hp
      rw [← hc]
      exact Ideal.comap_isPrime _ _
    · intro hp
      exact Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective hs hker
  · constructor
    · intro hm
      rw [← hc]
      exact Ideal.comap_isMaximal_of_surjective _ hs
    · intro hm
      rcases Ideal.map_eq_top_or_isMaximal_of_surjective _ hs hm with h1 | h1
      · exfalso
        apply hm.ne_top
        rw [← hc, h1, Ideal.comap_top]
      · exact h1
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [CommRing A] (I J : Ideal A), I ≤ J → ((J.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).IsPrime ↔ J.IsPrime) ∧ ((J.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).IsMaximal ↔ J.IsMaximal)
